def _kernel(x, w):
    linear = x @ w.T / x.shape[1]
    r = .5 * np.abs(x[:, None, :] - w[None, :, :])
    g = (1 + r + r*r/3)*np.exp(-r)
    avg = g.mean(2)
    pair = avg*avg - (g*g).sum(2)/x.shape[1]**2
